title: A decision that starts to grow
meaning: Your shared will takes shape through creating something when the wish to develop it rests on the continuing agreement of you both.
text: A decision made together can become the beginning of something living and gradually growing. The Empress in the physical position of Manipura describes creative action: choosing materials, experimenting and tending the result. The Empress in energy identifies the motive, wanting your shared idea to develop and bear tangible fruit. The Lovers in emotions let you experience this as agreement between you. The repeated card distinguishes how you work from why you invest yourselves, while mutual affection helps the undertaking remain a choice you both recognise as your own.

Imagine deciding to grow herbs on a windowsill. You choose pots together, find space and watch for the first shoots. **A shared decision grows stronger when both recognise their wish in the result.** You can enjoy different parts of the process: sowing might interest one person, while arranging the plants appeals to the other. Participation and influence over what happens next keep the small undertaking shared.

The difficulty begins if caring for growth starts justifying every expansion. More pots and tasks appear, although the original agreement concerned a much smaller idea. Declining the next step can then sound like rejecting togetherness. Creating retains its warmth when agreement can develop alongside the undertaking. Yesterday’s “yes” need not cover everything the two of you might imagine tomorrow.
